The '''Monocycle''' was a [[wheel bike]] produced by [[Koensayr Manufacturing/Legends|Koensayr Manufacturing]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Koensayr Monocycle was first added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' on [[May 4]], [[2015]] as part of the Core Worlds and Deep Core Explorer's Packs.

The real-life counterpart to the Monocycle is the [[Wikipedia:Monowheel|monowheel]].
